step1_analysis.circuit_type: Fully Differential Transconductor (Gm cell) with Enable
step1_analysis.description: A fully differential transconductance amplifier used in continuous-time analog filters. It features a main differential pair with PMOS active loads, a common-mode feedback (CMFB) control node, and a dummy differential pair used for power-down mode or common-mode stabilization when the main cell is disabled.

paper_reference.title: A 1 GHz CMOS Analog Front-End for a Generalized PRML Read Channel

DC_Gain.description: Low-frequency differential voltage gain of the transconductor.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/Vov. With W/L=5/0.5 and two parallel tail transistors, Id_tail ~ 200uA, so Id_branch ~ 100uA. Assuming Vov ~ 0.2V, gm ~ 1mS. Rout = ro_n || ro_p ~ 1/(lambda*Id) || 1/(lambda*Id) = 100k || 100k = 50kOhm. Gain = gm * Rout = 50 V/V = 34 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using standard square-law approximations for SKY130 1.8V devices with L=0.5um. Matches the typical 30 dB gain reported in the paper for similar stages.

Bandwidth.description: -3dB cutoff frequency of the voltage gain with a specified load capacitance.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * C_load). With Rout = 50 kOhm and C_load = 50 fF, BW = 1 / (2 * pi * 50k * 50f) = 63.6 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The cell bandwidth depends heavily on the load capacitance. While the overall filter operates at 1 GHz, the open-loop -3dB bandwidth of a single high-gain Gm cell is lower; the unity-gain frequency is what supports the 1 GHz operation.

Unity_Gain_Frequency.description: Frequency at which the differential voltage gain drops to 0 dB.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly reported for the cell

sky130_expected.calculation: UGF = gm / (2 * pi * C_load). With gm = 1 mS and C_load = 50 fF, UGF = 1e-3 / (2 * pi * 50e-15) = 3.18 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: To support a 1 GHz continuous-time filter, the unity-gain frequency of the individual transconductors must be significantly higher than 1 GHz to minimize excess phase shift.

Power_Consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the cell from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = VDD * I_total. I_total is dominated by the tail current (approx 200 uA). Power = 1.8 V * 200 uA = 360 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports power for the entire analog front-end (240 mW at 3.3V). A single Gm cell consumes a small fraction of this, scaled down further by the 1.8V supply in SKY130.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, -3dB bandwidth, unity-gain frequency, and power consumption of the fully differential Gm cell. An ideal behavioral CMFB loop is used to stabilize the output common-mode voltage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Gm Cell Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm2d=5u L_xm2d=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm1d=5u L_xm1d=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u

* DUT
XM2D N0 VBIAS_EN_BAR GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2d} w={W_xm2d}
XM5 N1 VBIAS_EN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM8 CM I_MINUS N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM1D CM I_PLUS N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1d} w={W_xm1d}
XM2 N1 VBIAS_EN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM6 N0 VBIAS_EN_BAR GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 O_PLUS I_MINUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM3 O_MINUS CMFB N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM9 O_PLUS CMFB N12 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM1 O_MINUS I_PLUS N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM4 N4 VDD_EN_BAR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM12 N12 VDD_EN_BAR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}

* Biasing and Supplies
V_VDD VDD 0 1.8
V_VBIAS_EN VBIAS_EN 0 1.8
V_VBIAS_EN_BAR VBIAS_EN_BAR 0 0
V_VDD_EN_BAR VDD_EN_BAR 0 0
V_CM CM 0 0.9

* Ideal CMFB Loop to stabilize output common-mode at 0.9V
B_CMFB CMFB 0 V='0.9 + 10*(v(O_PLUS)+v(O_MINUS)-1.8)'

* Inputs
V_IN_CM IN_CM 0 0.9
V_IN_D IN_D 0 0 ac 1 sin(0 0.1 100Meg)
E_IN_P I_PLUS IN_CM IN_D 0 0.5
E_IN_M I_MINUS IN_CM IN_D 0 -0.5

* Loads
C_L1 O_PLUS 0 50f
C_L2 O_MINUS 0 50f

* Differential Output for Measurement
E_DIFF OUT_DIFF 0 O_PLUS O_MINUS 1

.control
* DC Operating Point and Power
op
let power = -i(V_VDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1Meg 10G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT_DIFF)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db='dc_gain-3' fall=1
meas ac unity_gain_freq when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 10p 20n
meas tran vout_pp pp v(OUT_DIFF)
.endc
